page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with German, Italian and Latin verb paradigms; braces with grouped forms at left and right of the German and Latin columns; page number top right.

main_text.p: Daß wir solten haben, Ihr soltet haben Sie solten haben } gehabt, }
Che tu haueresti, Che colui hauerebbe & haueria, hauu- to,
Che noi haueremmo, Che voi hauereste, Coloro hauerebbono & haueriano, haun- to,
Daß ich, du, er, hätte, hättest gehabt, Daß wir, jhr, sie, hätten, hättet gehabt.
main_text.head: Futurum subjunctiui.
main_text.p: wen ich werd Quädo io hauero Cum ego habuero,
wen du wirst Tu haueraì, tu habueris,
wen er wird Colui hauerà, ille habuerit,
w. wir werde Noi haueremo, nos habuerimus
wen jr werdet Voi hauerete, vos habueritis,
wen sie werden haben gehabt. Coloro hauerano illi habuerint.
main_text.head: Infinit. modus temp. præf.

page.notes: Braces and bracketed grouping labels (haunto) at the margins are reproduced as near as legible; the German and Italian columns are printed in parallel with braces; some tail-line accents and spacing are approximate. Page is largely a grammar table.
